negative_reviews.author: Aya Gurashi
negative_reviews.text: The food was good and very tasty, nice restaurant.

negative_reviews.author: 赵芮禾
negative_reviews.text: (Translated by Google) It's just average, nothing special. (Original) 普普通通，感觉很一般

negative_reviews.author: Tegan Young
negative_reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend went for an early dinner to try out the new restaurant in West Quay. There was a small queue when we got there with just one person greeting and seating people. The restaurant was lovely and tidy and the food was incredible. When we ordered, our server did not seem very interested as we did not want any sides/extras. After we asked for the bill, it took about 10 mins just to get the card reader when other tables could pay immediately. Food was lovely but service may feel rushed.

negative_reviews.author: Christopher Ansell
negative_reviews.text: Would not recommend, the service was very chaotic as we had maybe 6 different servers throughout the 30 mins we were there. The food was ok, but seeing as Wagamama is next door I would always go there as it is better, cheaper and larger portions.
